t: DEWALT DCD778M2T-SFGB 18V XR brushless cordless combi drill delivers powerful and efficient performance for drilling and screwdriving applications. An advanced brushless motor ensures extended run time and durability, ideal for electricians and general builders working with masonry, wood, and steel, and the 13mm keyless chuck allows quick bit changes. Features 65Nm torque and 15 torque settings, plus drill and hammer drill modes, to offer precise control. An integrated LED work light illuminates dark areas, and the ergonomic soft-grip handle enhances user comfort. Supplied with 2 x 4.0Ah Li-Ion batteries and a TSTAK compatible carry case for convenient transport and storage.
